artifact.title: ISGs that failed to validate: 28 overexpression hits absent from the lentivirus table
artifact.description: The 28 genes that scored inhibitory in the overexpression screen and do not appear in the lentivirus validation table. These genes failed to reproduce their effect when delivered by lentiviral transduction. Note that MLKL, the second strongest inhibitor in the primary screen, is among them.
